lines.en: I flick my tail fan and shoot backward.
In water I glide faster than any crab.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流找你的方向。
lines.en: I follow the current toward you.
Antennae probe first, then my body follows.
Six hit points, yet I swim light.
I weave in and out of the coral.
My master beckons and I swim over.
Pushing off again and again, I close in.
I sweep a line across the sandy floor.
My shell is half transparent.
I swim without direction, as if searching.
Weeds snag my antennae; I shake them off.
Do not expect me to crawl; I only swim.

lines.zh: 这一带的水，我绕了三圈。
lines.en: I have circled these waters three times.

lines.zh: 主人一挥手，我就转向那边。
lines.en: My master waves, and I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我把钳子收在腹下，游得更快。
lines.en: I tuck my claws under and swim faster.

lines.zh: 气泡从我壳边擦过，一碰就破。
lines.en: Bubbles graze my shell and pop.

lines.zh: 我在石缝边停一下，再往前窜。
lines.en: I pause by the crevice, then dart on.
I hover in the water, legs paddling slowly.

lines.zh: 触须一抖，抓住一只小虫。
lines.en: My antennae twitch and catch a tiny bug.
With no target, I drift with the water.
My master is silent, so I stay still.
I press myself flat against a rock.
The flesh in my shell shows faintly red.
I drop nothing; I am weightless.

lines.zh: 我数着鳃边冒出的气泡。
lines.en: I count the bubbles rising from my gills.
My tail fans once, then stops.

lines.zh: 我在等主人下一次挥手。
lines.en: I wait for my master's next wave.
Water passes my gills, quite cold.
I blink my pair of black eyes.
These waters are too quiet.

lines.zh: 我缩起脚，装成一颗石子。
lines.en: I tuck my legs in and pass for a pebble.

lines.zh: 你在水边站着，我看得清。
lines.en: You stand by the water; I see you clearly.
I rise, antennae pointed at you.
You are much smaller than my master.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the sound of you wading.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，量你的肩宽。
lines.en: I turn broadside to measure your shoulders.
A net in your hand? I hate nets.
Do not reach out; I will dart away.

lines.zh: 水里你的倒影比实物瘦。
lines.en: Your reflection looks thinner than you do.

lines.zh: 我绕你的靴子游了半圈。
lines.en: I swim half a lap around your boots.
My master says you are prey.
My shell dented; I shudder.
That blow sank me half a foot.
Six hit points will not take a second blow.
I dart off with one antenna broken.
The pain stiffens my tail fan.
A thread of red spreads in the water.
I squeeze into a crevice to breathe.
My master has not come; I must hold on.
The shell's crack is soft, but I hear it.

lines.zh: 再挨一记，我就只剩壳渣。
lines.en: One more blow and only shell scraps remain.

lines.zh: 水里飘来的碎肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the scraps drifting in the water.
I will not eat what you hold; it is too dry.

lines.zh: 活下去靠小鱼，不靠面包。
lines.en: I live on small fish, not bread.

lines.zh: 你把食物沉下来，我再考虑。
lines.en: Sink the food, then I will consider it.
My antennae touched that piece of meat.
If my master does not allow it, I will not eat.

lines.zh: 这点碎末，连牙缝都塞不住。
lines.en: These crumbs would not fill a tooth gap.
The smell draws me two strokes closer.
I hold the food and keep watching you.
I may accept it, but do not touch my water.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖压弯了我的触须。
lines.en: Your knee bent my antennae sideways.
Your foot swept me aside.
Do not crowd me; my shell will crack.
You churned the current into a swirl.
I slip around your leg.
That bump pushed me back half a foot.
You stepped on my tail fan.

lines.zh: 我一弹退开，又贴回你脚边。
lines.en: I dart back, then cling to your feet again.
Make room; I am coming through.
Bump me once and I will remember it.

lines.zh: 小虾不谈伴侣，只谈活命。
lines.en: A shrimp speaks of survival, not partners.

lines.zh: 主人一挥手，同伴就多一只。
lines.en: One wave of my master's claw adds a companion.

lines.zh: 我们由召唤而来，不由繁衍。
lines.en: We come from summons, not from breeding.
Karcinogen and I are from the same batch.
Antennae touching antennae counts as meeting.

lines.zh: 海这么大，伴却只有主人。
lines.en: The sea is vast, but my only companion is my master.
I build no nest and hatch no eggs.

lines.zh: 想找伴？问巨蟹座的钳子。
lines.en: Looking for a mate? Ask Karkinos's claw.
Companions are summoned and scattered in a blink.
My life is short; no time for romance.
I do not pick things up; the water is full of junk.

lines.zh: 那块鳞片，我用触须拨开。
lines.en: That scale I brush aside with my antennae.
I have no hands, only thin legs.
Holding loot would only weigh down my strokes.
What my master drops, I dare not touch.
I pinch it once and let go.

lines.zh: 掉落物沉底，我也沉下去看。
lines.en: Loot sinks; I sink to look at it.
These crumbs are not worth carrying.
You pick it up; I will watch for you.
I nudge that little pebble.

lines.zh: 水里有动静，我转过去了。
lines.en: Something moved in the water; I turn to it.
Found you; my tail fan snaps.
I swim where my master points.
Your body heat reaches me through the water.
I approach along the bottom.

lines.zh: 这目标只够我咬一小口。
lines.en: That target is barely one small bite.
I first circle to downstream of you.
You have not noticed me yet.
Six hit points for one hit on you is fair.
Locked on; my antennae stiffen.
I halt inside your shadow.
My tail fan beats slowly, waiting.

lines.zh: 你一转腰，我就换了侧面。
lines.en: When you twist, I switch to your other side.
There is no sound in the water but me.
Your legs are the softest spot.
I measure the gap: two feet.
Hold still; I am taking aim.
My master blocks your way out.
The closer I cling, the harder I am to shake.

lines.zh: 这口咬法，我在小虾身上练过。
lines.en: I rehearsed this bite on many shrimp.
I shoot up and stab your hand.
Four points of damage, delivered in a flash.
Antennae wrap first, then my tail fan shoves.
You cannot shake me off.
I bite down on your knuckle.
The water bursts and I pull back.

lines.zh: 这记是替巨蟹座出的手。
lines.en: This strike is dealt for Karkinos.
My shell hits with a crisp sound.
Your arm jerks; I cling again.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的关节，我也敢钻。
lines.en: Even an iron golem's joints I dare to enter.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，我在水里睁眼。
lines.en: The egg cracks and I open my eyes underwater.

lines.zh: 主人召我，我从深处上来。
lines.en: My master calls and I rise from the depths.

lines.zh: 没有巢，我出生就在水里。
lines.en: No nest; I was born in open water.
Just formed, my shell is still soft.
Where is my master? I swim a lap first.
Do I know these waters? Not at all.

lines.zh: 我和小蟹座一起被放下。
lines.en: Karcinogen and I were placed together.
Six hit points are enough for one attempt.
My tail fan opens for the first time.

lines.zh: 水里多了两只，海就挤了。
lines.en: Two more in the water and the sea feels crowded.
Boiling water curls my shell.

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，我弹了两下。
lines.en: I hit the stone and bounce twice.
With gills like mine, I still feel stifled.
The blast throws me out of the water.
An arrowhead lodges in my shell seam.
The violet light numbs my tail fan.
Hunger makes my antennae droop.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I convulse.
Around me there is not even water.
